title: Rugged Rocky Coastline and Tidal Ocean Pool, 1950s B&W Seascape Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a dramatic, windswept coastal view with jagged, dark rock formations framing a natural or semi-enclosed ocean tide pool. Seawater fills the flat basin and cascades in delicate curtains over the outer rocky rim into the open, choppy ocean under an overcast sky. The scalloped deckle edges and corner album shadow marks on the reverse indicate this print was lovingly preserved in a mid-20th-century family travel album.
